name: Minimalist
description: Minimalist is the software development studio I founded and where my client work lives. We design and build software that does exactly what it should, performs without friction, and stands the test of time. Few projects at a time, on purpose, with no layers between you and the people writing the code.

services.title: Product design & development
services.description: From a blank page to a product in the market. Discovery, interface design, architecture and delivery handled by one team, so nothing is lost between the idea and the thing people actually use.

services.title: Custom software
services.description: Internal systems built around how the work actually happens, not around what an off-the-shelf tool allows. Integrations with the systems already in place, and only the features the business will really use.

services.title: Modernization
services.description: Fragile systems rebuilt into clean architecture, nothing lost. Legacy behaviour is documented and preserved, the codebase becomes safe to change, and the migration happens in steps instead of one risky rewrite.

services.title: Technical strategy
services.description: A second senior opinion before the expensive decision. Architecture reviews, technology choices, delivery planning and code audits, written down clearly enough for both engineers and stakeholders to act on.

process.title: Discovery
process.description: We learn the business, the constraints, and what is actually broken.

process.title: Definition
process.description: Scope, price and timeline fixed in writing before anything is built.

process.title: Design
process.description: Flows and interface built around the decisions a user actually makes.

process.title: Build
process.description: Clean architecture, tested code, weekly builds you can click.

process.title: Launch
process.description: Deployment, monitoring and handover documentation in place.

process.title: Support
process.description: A named engineer stays on, month to month, no lock-in.
